issues.detail: The Hebrew 'הוּא' is singular ('he/it'), but the Vietnamese renders 'chúng' (plural 'they/their'). This changes the subject from singular to plural.
The possessive suffixes 'מִשְׁפָּטוֹ וּשְׂאֵתוֹ' are singular ('his judgment and his dignity'), but the Vietnamese 'của chúng' is plural ('their'). This is a number error.
